cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Enjoy your afternoon off. Your bike will be ready for tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's the repair shop asking me to collect a wheel?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. They've got your number on the ticket. I'll collect everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A wheel? Is the rest at another shop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until four. Stay with your book; I've planned a route that gets all of it home before you need it.

mechanism: A controls permission to investigate a bicycle repair while handling its scattered logistics personally to protect B time off.
confusable: Simple secretiveness is insufficient: A effort and B protected rest must make the kindness motive clear.
comparison: A book-filled afternoon is shielded from multiple shop collections, unlike the night-shift partner and disrupted bedroom.
seedUse: D39-b already joins question deferral with directed leisure and a personally planned restoration route.
